Class ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.auditing.AuditingHandlerSupport
org.springframework.data.auditing.ReactiveAuditingHandler
org.springframework.data.auditing.ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler
public class ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler extends ReactiveAuditingHandler
扩展了AuditingHandler，它使用PersistentEntity.isNew(Object)来暴露一个通用的 markAudited(Object)方法。该方法将根据工厂确定的IsNewStrategy，将调用路由到 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markCreated(Object)或 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markModified(Object)。
Since:
2.4
Author:
马克·帕卢赫
